description: This PHP class defines a model for accessing stock status data in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods to retrieve individual stock status records and lists of stock status records from the database, with caching support.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Model class for handling stock status data, including retrieval and caching mechanisms in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getStockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stock status record from the database based on the given stock status ID.

methods.name: getStockStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of stock status records, with optional filtering, ordering, and pagination, utilizing caching for performance.
